summary: Implemented prepareUpdate following the prepareQuery pattern. Changes: added an Update class in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py (holds the translated algebra); added prepareUpdate in processor.py, which sets _original_args; made SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update and evalUpdate in update.py unwrap an Update into its algebra; exported prepareUpdate from rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py; added test/test_sparql_prepare_update.py with four tests. Nothing was run and nothing was committed, per instructions. The tests were verified by reading only. SPARQLStore and the memory store still accept only strings, the same as prepared queries, so prepared updates do not reach SPARQL endpoints. That is left as a follow-up.
